_doc: The world map. Regions are Voronoi cells about 'regionSize' metres across; neighbouring regions never share a biome (with five biomes), the start region is 'home', and borders wander by up to 'warp' metres and blend over 'border' metres. Each biome dresses its ground and scatter, and 'mobs' weights which anomaly kinds spawn there; 'grass' sets the blades: 'density' as a share of the most (0 is bare), 'height' in metres, 'heightVariation' from 0 (all fully grown) to 1 (growth comes in waves, down to fresh sprouts), 'dryGrass' the share that grows on the dry patches (0 where they are water or ash); 'strayShare' of spawns come from any other kind. Prop 'scale' is a random range, 'block' the blocking radius in metres at scale 1 (0 is decoration); 'w' 0 keeps a prop out of the scatter but in the painter's palette (the mossy arch capital floats 2.8 m up and only works on a pillar). 'packs' map a mesh's folder under assets/synty to its palette atlas and unit scale (the Dungeon pack's FBX are in centimetres). Each region also tries to place 'setPiecesPerRegion' hand-made set pieces from data/setpieces (made with run.cmd --paint) of its biome.
